question: How many of the 200 smallest positive integers are congruent to 1 (mod 9)?
solution:
The positive integers congruent to 1 modulo 9 have the form 1 + 9k for integers k ≥ 0. To be among the first 200, they must satisfy 1 + 9k ≤ 200, so 9k ≤ 199. Since 199 = 9·22 + 1, k ranges from 0 through 22, giving 22 − 0 + 1 = 23 integers.
Final answer: 23
